status: Freeze source and protocol before deriving study outcomes; all historical results exploratory
purpose: Bounded CPU screen of longer forecast horizon and additional year history, not JEV/RL or a pattern-detector ablation
universe: All 50 names in the verified Experiment 06 surviving universe; no new acquisition
cohort: Actual SPY week-end sessions shared by ticker; require 252 stock and SPY sessions and complete 20-session outcome; no outcome/pattern balancing

target.definition: Adjusted close[t+h]/close[t]-1; sample std ddof=1 of 60 trailing overlapping h-session returns; Flat strict abs return < sigma/3; equality directional
target.convention: After-close research forecast, no executable entry or net P&L

features.current: 5 daily bars at full resolution, 20 daily bars at full resolution, 100 daily bars on a 16-position grid; 9 summaries per view
features.added_year: 252 daily sessions aggregated to W-FRI OHLCV, partial boundary weeks use only visible bars; 16-position grid and same 9 summaries
features.shared_context: Horizon-specific causal sigma; current SPY 100-session return/std/range; multiscale adds year SPY return/std/range
features.forbidden: Ticker/date/identity, future return, target_date, label, test-derived calibration and named pattern flags

purge: Identical fold rows for both horizons/views: max of both training target dates must precede first test 252-session information_start; annual fixed fits only preceding five calendar years; common longest-history purge
controls: Multiscale training labels shuffled as date vectors within identical ticker coverage

uncertainty.method: Circular moving blocks of retained weekly forecast dates, all tickers together; row-weighted; conditional on fitted predictions; approximate stationarity

decision.family: Bonferroni approximate 5% family across two prespecified CPU decisions
decision.longer_horizon_gate: 20-session current model paired Brier reduction vs prior has positive 97.5% primary-block CI and at least 5/7 positive years
decision.year_view_gate: 20-session multiscale vs current has positive 97.5% primary-block CI, at least 5/7 positive years, and point Brier below its prior
decision.action: Passing motivates separately frozen independent confirmation; no automatic GPU operation. Failure is a stopping signal for this fixed numerical design, not proof all models lack information.
